title: Active catalog
prompt: Return sku, product_name for active products, sorted by sku.

title: Pending orders
prompt: Return order_id,customer_id for pending orders, sorted by order_id.

title: Customer city
prompt: Return full_name,email for customers from Bucharest, sorted by full_name.

title: Most expensive products
prompt: Return sku,unit_price_cents for top 3 most expensive products, price DESC then sku ASC.

title: Products per category
prompt: Return category_name,product_count for every category (include empty), sorted by name.

title: Orders by status
prompt: Return status,order_count for each present status, sorted by status.

title: Customers with zero orders
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name for customers with no orders, sorted by id.

title: Employee and manager
prompt: Return employee,manager for every employee (NULL manager if none), in employee_id order.

title: Line-item totals
prompt: Return order_id,product_name,quantity,line_cents for all order items; sort by order_id,product_name.

title: Paid order totals
prompt: Return order_id,total_cents for paid orders using item price*quantity; sorted by id.

title: Never ordered SKUs
prompt: Return sku,product_name for products never referenced in order_items, sorted by sku.

title: Recent orders
prompt: Return order_id,ordered_at of latest 3 orders by date DESC,id DESC.

title: Repeat order customers
prompt: Return customer_id,order_count for customers with >=2 orders of any status, sorted by id.

title: Payment method totals
prompt: Return method,total_cents (sum of payments), sorted by method.

title: Customer 1 order history
prompt: Return order_id,ordered_at for customer_id=1, sorted latest date then highest id.

title: Average category price
prompt: Return category_name,avg_price_cents for all categories (NULL if empty), sorted by name.
